## What changed

- Observed result:

## Review checklist

- [ ] Widths, signedness, rounding, saturation and reset behaviour are explicit where relevant.
- [ ] New behaviour has a deterministic test or assertion.
- [ ] The control/baseline still differs by only the declared mechanism.
- [ ] Failed, refused and invalid outcomes remain visible.
- [ ] No credentials, licensed datasets, build directories or unapproved large binaries are included.
- [ ] The README or manifest contains any new command, parameter or dependency.
- [ ] The group's `EVALUATION.md` table links the retained run and records any new observation.
- [ ] Another team member reviewed the change and can explain it.
